item.title: New poll shows bipartisan support for public charter schools
item.description: Alabama voters don’t always agree — but on public education, the message is clear: parents want more options, and they support public charter schools as part of a strong public education system.

item.title: First Baptist Church Leroy associate pastor retires
item.description: David “Dave” Delegal recently retired as associate pastor of First Baptist Church Leroy where he served for more than 33 years.

item.title: Riverside Baptist Church dedicates new building
item.description: Riverside Baptist Church held a ribbon-cutting ceremony Dec. 7 to celebrate the dedication of its new building.

item.title: First Baptist Church Montgomery admin assistant retires
item.description: Mary Virginia Crum recently retired as an administrative assistant with First Baptist Church Montgomery.

item.title: Latest news: Winter storm relief efforts; Jesus Film Project’s growing digital focus
item.description: Check out these recent headlines, reported by The Baptist Paper.

item.title: Lafitte Baptist in Saraland celebrates 50th anniversary
item.description: Lafitte Baptist Church, Saraland, celebrated its 50th anniversary Jan. 24–25. Saturday’s event featured The Kendricks, a country gospel band.

item.title: New study Bible focuses on discipling women
item.description: Stefana Dan Laing, an associate professor at Samford University’s Beeson Divinity School in Birmingham, spent the evening of Jan. 27 celebrating the launch of the new CSB Women’s Study Bible.

item.title: Officials address plight of 2 abducted girls
item.description: Pakistani judges have ordered police to find and present to the court a kidnapped girl and her abductor.

item.title: 177 Christians kidnapped in one day in Nigeria
item.description: Extremists invaded three churches simultaneously on Jan. 18, kidnapping 177 Christians, and Nigerian officials initially appeared to deny the incident.

item.title: Who is George Liele? What your church should know.
item.description: We hear about George Liele every year during the Southern Baptist Convention’s George Liele Church Planting, Evangelism and Missions Sunday (Feb. 1). But who is this celebrated man? What every church should know about George Liele
